title: Kulbergs plans to axe Climate and Energy Ministry, ponders special portfolios
summary_full: Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) signalled on Monday that he intends to shake up the shape of government, cutting at least one ministry and potentially inviting people from outside politics to take charge at other ministries.
